halfLife.notes: Long half-life supports once-daily dosing. Steady state in 2 weeks. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: Dehydro-aripiprazole
activeMetabolite.notes: Active metabolite contributes ~40% of total exposure; half-life ~94h. Combined effective half-life is what enables LAI dosing intervals. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors (paroxetine, fluoxetine) and CYP3A4 inhibitors raise levels — halve dose if combined. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Among the most metabolically neutral SGAs — frequently chosen as a switch target when olanzapine or quetiapine cause weight gain. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: Abilify Maintena (monthly). Switching from oral to LAI requires oral overlap during initial titration. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Long half-life provides intrinsic taper. Akathisia rather than rebound is the main switch concern. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Tablets only in MY. Akathisia is the most common dose-limiting AE — counsel patients to report restlessness early. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
